claim_policy: DocFlow's committed public regression set is not an external benchmark.
Do not claim BEIR, MTEB, or C-MTEB scores until the corresponding benchmark run is completed and archived.
Release notes may quote external benchmark results only when the benchmark name, task split, model config, hardware, and result artifact are listed.

benchmarks.name: BEIR
benchmarks.scope: Heterogeneous information retrieval benchmark for zero-shot retrieval evaluation.

benchmarks.name: MTEB
benchmarks.scope: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark for embedding and retrieval systems.

benchmarks.name: C-MTEB
benchmarks.scope: Chinese Massive Text Embedding Benchmark covering Chinese embedding tasks and datasets.
